newsitem.title: USA: Wells-Gardner sees Q2 EPS above year ago $0.03.
newsitem.headline: Wells-Gardner sees Q2 EPS above year ago $0.03.

text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp, a computer monitor manufacturer, said Monday it expects second quarter net income to exceed the $151,000, or $0.03 a share reported a year ago.
The company also said it expects its second quarter, 1997 sales to increase to between $11 and $12 million from $9.2 million in the second quarter, 1996.

"The primary increases have come from the service, bartop and gaming markets," Anthony Spier, chief executive officer, said in a news release. "This sales growth is being driven by new products, which account for over 90 percent of the company's 1997 sales."
The company also said it expects to begin shipping its new monitor product early in the third quarter.
Wells-Gardner shares were unchanged at four Monday.
